Owners bedroom and retreat remain neutral; no newly introduced purple, blue or pink bedroom textiles. Dark charcoal cushions can appear warmer under night light.
Keep platform-bed intent, gentle underside light and floating walnut bedside consoles, paired neutral art above the bed, and a 55-inch TV with soundbar on the opposite solid wall.

Preserve approved Study A pearl onyx-look porcelain at the owners-bath tub focal wall and shower surfaces, walnut vanity and pale floor. The previously accepted small plum towel/art note in this bathroom remains; the later neutral-bedroom instruction does not undo Study A.

Bedroom/retreat form one open sleep-darkening zone. Close every real exterior window blackout layer at night; keep the interior connection open.
